description: Turn one production fact table into a shop-floor dashboard. Production Tracker shows, for every machine, how much was produced, whether the daily target was met, the OEE (Availability x Performance x Quality), and a planned vs. unplanned downtime breakdown - with no DAX measures required. FREE VERSION - TRY IT ON YOUR OWN DATA No licence and no sign-up. Install the visual, bind your data and use it straight away, in Power BI Desktop and in the Power BI service alike: - The Production Overview chart and the full Table view, including totals - Every filter: shift, line, location, product, category and date range - The complete shift schedule: 12 templates plus named planned-stop categories, which drive Open Time, the daily target and OEE - Up to 20 machines WHAT A LICENCE ADDS - Tiles view - one card per machine with KPIs, downtime badges and a target-colour edge - OEE view - Availability, Quality and Performance as circular gauges, for the plant and per machine - Daily Report - a full-screen, shift-ready summary with status, four KPI cards and a per-machine table - Unlimited machines VIEWERS ARE ALWAYS FREE Only the person who edits the report needs a licence. Everyone who simply views the report sees the full, configured visual at no cost - which is what makes this practical for shop-floor screens and control rooms, where many people watch one report.
